name: Miso Butter Pasta with Deli Turkey, Roast Squash, Mushrooms & Walnuts

instructions.primary_message: Place butternut squash and mushrooms on a baking sheet pan. Season with salt and pepper, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 cups frozen butternut squash, pieces
1 (227 g) pkg sliced white mushrooms
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Small dice butter; sprinkle half over the veggies. (Place remaining butter in a small bowl and set aside.)
Place baking sheet in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, stirring veggies halfway through, until fork-tender, 15-20 minutes. Remove from oven.

Meanwhile, fill a medium saucepan about halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until desired firmness, 8-10 minutes. (Reserve a ¼-cup cooking water before draining and set aside.)
While the pasta is cooking, peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the remaining butter along with miso paste, additional salt, and pepper. Mash with the back of a spoon to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 clove garlic
1 tbsp miso paste, red
salt
black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Roughly chop walnuts. Add to the bowl with the miso butter and set aside.
Stack turkey slices one on top of another, then medium dice.
instructions.secondary_message: 227 g oven roasted turkey breast, sliced

instructions.primary_message: When the pasta is done, drain and return to the pan. Add roasted veggies, walnuts, miso butter, turkey, reserved pasta water, and Parmesan, then stir to combine.
To serve, divide pasta between plates or bowls. Enjoy!
